name: Rie
source:
Age: Appears as 16
Specialization: Astrological Witchcraft
Main Element: Earth
Secondary Element: Fire
History: Rie and her younger twin sister Rena come directly into Astral from outside world, because of this she has
a lot more vivid memories of an outside world than the rest of Astral's residents witch resulted in her luck of trust toward anyone other than her sister.
Personality: Cold and Composed, others see her as cool and a bit mysterious, likes to stick to herself and doesn't
often show emotions but can get very passionate from time to time, especially when it comes to her younger
twin sister.
